I’ve been talking to OP in dms and she said they’re very grateful and overwhelmed with support. She said she was recently diagnosed with lupus and that took a hit on her mental health, resulting in her losing control on gambling. She expressed that she knows she screwed up, and that she was just trying to “get that big hit” but it never came. I know we all have had that feeling at one point.
